parameters.query:
with candidate as materialized (
  select
    ci.content_id,
    ci.title,
    ci.category,
    ci.target_duration_seconds,
    ci.source_payload_json,
    s.raw_response_json,
    coalesce(s.raw_response_json->'scene_guidance_json', '[]'::jsonb) as script_scene_guidance_json,
    sb.storyboard_json,
    sb.subtitle_lines_json,
    sb.render_manifest_seed_json,
    coalesce(sb.cover_prompt, '') as cover_prompt,
    coalesce(sb.style_notes, '') as style_notes
  from content_items ci
  join scripts s on s.content_id = ci.content_id
  join storyboards sb on sb.content_id = ci.content_id
  where ci.status = 'storyboard_complete'
  order by ci.updated_at asc
  limit 1
), claim as (
  update content_items ci
  set status = 'validating',
      updated_at = now()
  where ci.content_id = (select content_id from candidate)
    and ci.status = 'storyboard_complete'
  returning ci.content_id
)
select
  c.content_id,
  c.title,
  c.category,
  c.target_duration_seconds,
  c.source_payload_json,
  c.raw_response_json,
  c.script_scene_guidance_json,
  c.storyboard_json,
  c.subtitle_lines_json,
  c.render_manifest_seed_json,
  c.cover_prompt,
  c.style_notes
from candidate c
join claim cl on cl.content_id = c.content_id;

update content_items
set status = 'validation_complete',
    updated_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid
  and status = 'validating'
returning content_id, title, status, updated_at;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Validation SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  'wf_validation_check',
  'success',
  now(),
  now(),
  {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Validation SQL Values"].json["duration_ms_sql"]}},
  null,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'scene_count', {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Validation SQL Values"].json["scene_count_sql"]}},
    'total_duration_seconds', {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Validation SQL Values"].json["total_duration_seconds_sql"]}},
    'validation_summary', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Validation SQL Values"].json["validation_summary_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb,
    'cost', '{}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, ended_at;
